dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from dark perimeters to light interiors. Three prominent rings on the mid-dorsal surface show irregular, serrated outer edges with a sharp gradient shift. Ring diameter varies from roughly 5% to 8% of the total visible body length.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of dark, low-intensity pixel clusters on the anterior upper flank. Large, continuous regions of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels are concentrated on the posterior lower flank, lacking internal texture or gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle. A second geometric relationship is observable connecting the centermost annulus to the centroids of two high-intensity light blobs on the lower lateral region.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized, high-intensity yellow/white elliptical pixel cluster is visible in the anterior-most dark section, contrasting sharply with the surrounding low-luminance region.
